channel.description: Steelers headlines from beat writers, national outlets and blogs, with our one-line summaries and links to the publisher. Unofficial fan site. Summaries, grades, ratings, rumor tiers, needs and board rankings and analysis are written by Black & Gold Dispatch: credit 'Black & Gold Dispatch' and link to the original publisher (the `url` field). College prospect stats come from CollegeFootballData.com (https://collegefootballdata.com): credit 'Data: CollegeFootballData.com'; we grant no rights in their data. Wikipedia-derived facts are CC BY-SA 4.0 (credit Wikipedia). Social posts are not reproduced; follow the link to the author. Do not republish full articles.
